rationale: The short thesis is fully intact and working — price is pressing the $12.60-61 breakdown trigger at the session lows, still well below VWAP ($13.22) and the 9-EMA ($13.14), with no new headlines and no reversal signature (no VWAP reclaim, no capitulation spike), while the risk-off tape (SPY -0.74%, VIXY +2.66%) continues to favor downside drift. The entry trigger for the $12.30 target is being tested right now, so exiting here would abandon the trade at the moment of decision rather than on evidence of failure. A flip to long would fight the intraday trend with no supporting evidence, and closing locks in a profit the setup hasn't yet justified taking.
